title: BUGFIX — Replace stale /stats/health with /health across 4 script files
rationale: Sprint 1415 renamed Achiri health endpoint from /stats/health to /health. Five places still referenced the old path: init-hetzner.sh (curl health check), cmd-management.ts cmdBlockers() Hetzner check, cmd-stripe.ts (2 occurrences), and cmd-spielberg.ts cmdAchiriPing(). All returned 404 when called — Hetzner live-check always returned false, /achiri-ping always reported DOWN. Fixed: replaced all 5 stale /stats/health references with /health.
